plugins.name: protect-main-branch
plugins.description: Prevent git operations that would modify the main branch (or configured branches) in Claude Code. Individual subcommands can be opted out via PROTECT_MAIN_BRANCH_ALLOWED_SUBCOMMANDS.

plugins.name: session-handover
plugins.description: Reincarnation-style handover/takeover for Claude Code. Each agent self-names with an English first name and keeps an identity-scoped document at .claude/handover/<name>.md, split into a curated Knowledge block (stock) and an append-only History block (flow). A successor takes over an identity to inherit its memory, understanding, and experience.

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Retrospective skill based on a 6-stage process (input → interpretation → planning → action → inspection → output) to surface problems and apply improvements

plugins.name: session-tts
plugins.description: Read Claude Code responses aloud locally with a different Japanese voice per session. Instructs Claude to deliver mid-turn progress narration via a synchronous Bash call into the say adapter, plus a TodoWrite hook that nudges narration at task transitions. Permission prompts include the workspace name. ON by default; engine and models are managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.
